description: ADO-RESULTS, RecordsAffected written back through a by-reference argument: Connection.Execute with RecordsAffected passed as VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT holding Empty and as typed VT_BYREF|VT_I4 holding -5, for an UPDATE of three rows (L = 10), an UPDATE of none, an INSERT, a DELETE of two rows, a SELECT, a CREATE TABLE and a DROP TABLE; and Command.Execute(RecordsAffected, Parameters, Options) for an UPDATE. The value written back after each call is captured. Asks what ADO reports for each statement kind and whether a failing call writes back.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
